# Favicon Documentation

## Files Created

✅ **favicon.svg** - Modern SVG favicon with pink flower design
- Vector format, scales perfectly
- Pink gradient flower with golden center
- Small heart accent
- Soft pastel background (#ffeef8)

✅ **favicon.ico** - Classic ICO format for older browsers
- Multi-size: 16x16 and 32x32
- Fallback for browsers that don't support SVG

✅ **apple-touch-icon.png** - iOS home screen icon
- Size: 180x180px
- Shows when user adds site to home screen

✅ **manifest.json** - PWA manifest
- Allows installation as Progressive Web App
- Sets app name, colors, and icons

## Design Theme

The favicon features:
- **Pink flower** (🌸) - Representing memory garden theme
- **Soft pastels** - Calming and comforting colors
- **Small heart** - Symbol of love and memory
- **Golden center** - Hope and warmth

## Browser Support

- ✅ Modern browsers: Uses SVG (crisp on all displays)
- ✅ Safari/iOS: Uses apple-touch-icon.png
- ✅ Older browsers: Falls back to favicon.ico
- ✅ PWA support: manifest.json for installable app

## Colors Used

- Background: `#ffeef8` (soft pink)
- Flower petals: `#ff8fb5` → `#ff6b9d` (gradient)
- Center: `#ffd700` (golden)
- Accent heart: `#ff8fb5` (soft pink)

Perfect for a memorial/memory website with gentle, comforting aesthetics. 💗
